Cyabra's technology cuts through the noise to detect coordinated inauthentic activity, map evolving threat narratives, and deliver actionable intelligence to clients across the private and public sectors. We're looking for a hands-on, technically deep individual to own post-sale technical deployment and value realization for our most strategic clients. Conduct technical training sessions, workshops, and documentation to enable client teams to independently leverage the platform.
